scenes.text: Read large numbers in groups of three digits. Say the thousands group first, then the hundreds, tens and ones.
Choose the number name for 909,010. The answer is nine hundred and nine thousand ten. 909,010 is read as nine hundred and nine thousand ten.
A sign during a library project says “four hundred and eighty-seven thousand fifty”. Which numeral should be printed? Pause the video and think.
A sign during a library project says “four hundred and eighty-seven thousand fifty”. Which numeral should be printed? The answer is 487,050. Convert the place-value words to 487,050.
